patch_description:
Crossover ansatz combining the best motifs from the prior programs:
- Keeps the symmetry-compressed parameterization and motif-aligned three-qubit
  ZZZ and CCRZ interactions (as in the best-performing seed).
- Adds lightweight pre-phase control using the existing compact rotation
  parameters (reused keys) to regularize phase before entanglement, borrowing
  the pre-/post-rotation idea from the other variant while preserving
  parameter efficiency.
- Preserves shared CRZ ring and center couplings and grouped RY local
  rotations so the total unique parameters per block remains 13 (N_PARAMS=78),
  matching the strong-performing configuration.

The resulting block balances geometric motif expressivity (winning-line ZZZ/CCRZ)
with parameter efficiency and modest phase regularization, aiming to keep the
high validation accuracy and small generalization gap of the best seed while
retaining fast convergence under Adam.
